name: projectaurora-monorepo
description: ProjectAurora - Multi-Application Monorepo (PDF Tools & Multi-Site Admin)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/pdf && npm run build --workspace=apps/admin
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/pdf && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/admin
